sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online

Sec. 2 (pp. 50-51): Mbat tonal system 'still a work in progress'; three surface tone levels H, M, L (plus a Super-Low on the Habitual suffix), preliminary evidence for a four-way underlying tonal contrast plus toneless TBUs; fn. 4: no tonal alternations on stems under suffixation.
